caseMerge.title: Merge case twins
caseMerge.help: The NAS treats names that differ only in letter case (DIRE STRAITS and Dire Straits) as one, so scans miss the Files in them. The merge takes two phases. First, all but one of each set of twins get a temporary name ("Dire Straits [case-merge]"): a rename loses nothing, whichever twin the NAS reaches. Run it again until no twins are left, as twins inside twins only show once their folders are renamed. Then each renamed folder is merged into its partner, and the side with more Files wins. A File that is byte-identical to the one it would replace goes to Quarantine; any other clash is listed here for you to decide. Every Track keeps its favorites, ratings, plays and Playlist entries, and each run can be undone from the Edit history.

phase.rename: Phase 1 of 2: give the twins temporary names

promote.title: Promote to the Library
promote.help: Promote moves this card's Files from the Inbox to their place in the Library: <Album Artist>/<Album> (<Year>)/<NN> <Title>, or <D>-<NN> <Title> on a multi-disc album, as Organize names them. Nothing moves until you run the plan. The Tracks become visible to every Listener and keep their favorites, ratings, plays and Playlist entries, and the whole job can be undone from the Edit history, which puts the Files back in the Inbox.
promote.unsaved: Save or undo your changes first: Promote places the Files by the tags they have now.
